description: A quiet line in a stream whose rules draw out from its words, with a light that sweeps across it while the work it names is still going.
moves: A separator marker's rules draw outward from its words; a border marker's rule draws from the start of the line.
The icon lands with a little overshoot once the work it marks is done.
The words rise out of a soft blur; when a pending marker finishes, its new text rises in again.
While pending, a light sweeps across the words, then stops when the work is done.

propDocs.Marker.variant: `"separator"` draws a rule on each side of the content, `"border"` a rule under it, `"default"` neither.
propDocs.Marker.live: Reads the marker out when its text changes, as a status.
propDocs.Marker.pending: The work the marker names is still going on: a light sweeps across the words, and a live marker is marked busy.
